title: Transport properties of B-site codoped CaHfO3 proton conductors with octahedral distortion
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36782-36793
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06213B, Paper

Wenlong Huang, Mingze Lv, Ying Li, Yushi Ding, Jiayao Lu, Chunsheng Zhuang, Pengfei Yue, Wei Zhang
Both proton and oxygen ion mobility initially increase with octahedral distortion angle and then decrease, and CaHf0.8Sn0.1Sc0.1O3−δ with the octahedral distortion angle of 15.6° exhibited the highest ionic mobilities and conductivities.
